scenario_packs.raw_transcript:
Priya: ok so the 5-tier pricing doc -- sales says nobody understands the difference between Starter and Growth on the call, deals are stalling in the pricing conversation
Sam: yeah I pulled the last 12 lost deals, 7 of them mention confusion about tiers explicitly
Priya: what if we just collapse it to 3: Free, Pro, Enterprise
Sam: I think that works, we lose some of the granularity but the sales cycle speed is worth it
Priya: ok let's do that, going with 3 tiers -- Free / Pro / Enterprise, effective next pricing page update

decisions.decision_statement: Move from 5 pricing tiers to a simplified 3-tier structure: Free, Pro, Enterprise.
decisions.rationale: 7 of the last 12 lost deals cited tier confusion; simplifying should speed the sales cycle.

decisions.decision_statement: Launch with 5 pricing tiers: Free, Starter, Growth, Business, Enterprise.
decisions.rationale: Original plan to capture more price points across customer segments.

Summary: the March outage sat unacknowledged for 40 minutes because one engineer was the sole on-call and was asleep. Action: move to a weekly rotation across the backend team, with a designated secondary on-call for escalation if the primary doesn't ack within 10 minutes.

Owner: Priya. Status: adopted starting next sprint.

decisions.decision_statement: Adopt a weekly on-call rotation across the backend team with a secondary escalation on-call.
decisions.rationale: The March outage went unacknowledged 40 minutes under a single on-call; a secondary catches missed acks.

## Data Retention -- Raw Ingested Events

Decision: raw events (pre-chunking, pre-extraction) are retained for 30 days then purged.
Rationale: balances being able to debug/replay a pipeline issue against storage cost and data minimization -- 30 days covers essentially all support escalations we've seen historically.

decisions.decision_statement: Retain raw ingested events for 30 days before deletion.
decisions.rationale: Balances debugging/replay needs against storage cost and data minimization.

scenario_packs.raw_transcript:
## Application Log Retention

Decision: application logs (not raw ingested events -- separate system) are retained for 90 days in the hot tier, then archived to cold storage for 1 year.
Rationale: 90 days covers our typical incident post-mortem window; cold storage covers audits.

decisions.decision_statement: Retain application logs for 90 days hot, then 1 year in cold storage.
decisions.rationale: 90 days covers typical post-mortem windows; cold storage covers audit needs.

Decision: every SEV1/SEV2 incident gets a blameless postmortem doc within 3 business days, reviewed in the weekly eng sync. Action items get owners and due dates tracked in the same doc.
Rationale: several SEV2s in Q4 had no follow-up documented and recurred within weeks.

decisions.decision_statement: Require a blameless postmortem within 3 business days for every SEV1/SEV2 incident.
decisions.rationale: Several undocumented Q4 SEV2s recurred within weeks with no follow-up.

Priya: new features ship behind a flag now, 5% -> 25% -> 100% over a week unless something breaks
Sam: what's the rollback trigger
Priya: error rate over 2x baseline for 10 min auto-pages the on-call and we roll back the flag
Sam: love it, let's make that the default process for all new features

decisions.decision_statement: Roll out new features behind flags at 5% -> 25% -> 100% over a week, with auto-rollback on 2x error rate for 10 minutes.
decisions.rationale: Gives a controlled rollout with an automatic, objective rollback trigger.
